messages:
Maya: kicking off release v2026.03.1 to eu-west now — deploy-bot just started the rollout :rocket:
deploy-bot: rollout id=rl-2026-03-1 region=eu-west phase=staged percentage=10%
Jared: seeing a small p95 bump on the api-generate route in the dashboard (from ~120ms -> ~320ms) — is that the new tokenization change?
Priya: observed 5xx on the same route, error rate up to 1.9% from baseline 0.2% in last 2m. adding traces.
Samir: tagging ops: @Maya any safeguard pins or quick rollback plan?
Maya: hold traffic at 10% and don’t advance. I'm going to pull per-route metrics and if p95 stays >250ms for another 5m we rollback.
Priya: perf logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-21T10:12:02Z api-generate p95=318ms p50=92ms errors=2.1% 5xx=18/s
2026-03-21T10:12:07Z model-proxy queue-latency=40ms kv-cache-miss-rate=12%
```
Jared: looks like kv-cache miss rate spiked after muxing to quantized-encoder. could be warming issue.
Samir: I'm going to run a targeted prefix-warm for the canary with the warm script now.
ops-bot: warming job started job_id=warm-5280001111-1 target=canary-nodes region=eu-west
Priya: warming didn't drop miss rate enough — still ~10-12% after 90s. p95 unchanged.
Maya: decision: rollback the canary to stable model-3 for that route. I'll issue a rollback and pause the rollout.
Maya: rollback command:
```
# run from ops CLI
ops deploy rollback --rollout-id rl-2026-03-1 --target-version model-3 --region eu-west --confirm
```
deploy-bot: rollback initiated rl-2026-03-1 -> model-3 region=eu-west status=in_progress
Samir: starting route pin to stable-v3 to avoid flapping while rollback completes.
ops-bot: route pin applied route=api-generate -> stable-v3 scope=eu-west by=Samir
deploy-bot: rollback completed rl-2026-03-1 status=rolled_back completed_by=Maya duration=70s
Priya: post-rollback metrics: p95 back to ~130ms, 5xx down to 0.3% — looks healthy :thumbsup:
Maya: good. logging follow-up: open issue to add an automated kv-cache warm in preflight and add a synthetic that exercises tokenization around our heavy prefixes.
Jared: filing issue now — will link release notes and the observed traces.
Maya: thanks all. leaving the release notes draft in the release-notes doc and marking the rollout paused until warming + synthetic added. Closing this thread when ticket is triaged. :white_check_mark:
